answer: The tide counter is kept in copper and trellis shows each reset. A bond is refunded only after 26 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A hostile operator thus has to keep each duplicate self continuously active for 26 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. Each duplicate costs another 144 dollars in locked collateral and another 8 days of waiting. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
